ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactLoansCreditLimit_View]
	AS 

WITH FactLoansCreditLimit_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit as FDL
)

Select LNS.*
from DW.FactLoansCreditLimit as LNS
    INNER JOIN FactLoansCreditLimit_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = LNS.BusinessDateSK
